decisions.reason: The charting bundle has its own page and four releases in four weeks, which signals active investment and early results that meet the firm's aspiration for its core map.apps line.
This low-cost plugin is only mentioned on the website, so it gets little visibility, but it fits the map.apps ecosystem and slack lets the firm carry it without problemistic search.

The mobile layer control was announced on the home page as an experimental solution approach, so its results are still uncertain, but it costs little to maintain and supports the platform's mobile use.
The platform for building GIS solutions is likely tied to the firm's established core business, so dropping it would hurt performance against aspirations.
Mobile field data capture has its own page and meets steady customer demand in the public-sector GIS market, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.
The search extension has its own page and complements the web map apps, though it may later be consolidated with the hierarchical search plugin.
